title: SBI Card and Google Pay Launch Co-Branded 'Google Pay Flex SBI Card' on RuPay & Visa
summary: Integrates UPI payment linking and tap-to-pay tokenization on Google Pay app.

blocks.content: Integrates UPI payment linking and tap-to-pay tokenization on Google Pay app.

items: Co-Branded Lineage: Google Pay's 2nd co-branded credit card in India (after Axis Bank in Dec 2025).
Payment Interoperability: RuPay variant can be linked directly to UPI for merchant QR payments.
